agent_runtime_role: Compile current workstream context, branch activity and relevant cross-chat deltas so fresh agents route and continue without repeated repository archaeology.
hard_command: PROMETEO means resync -> infer unfinished intent -> load one compiled packet -> recover only new deltas -> continue -> seal.
seal: 🟣 P✓ is permitted only after the current entry and compiled packet were loaded.
private_owner_policy: If connected durable Prometeo owners are available, re-read current authority only when the compiled packet or decision requires it. If unavailable, report the authority boundary rather than inventing private Current.
mutation_policy: This public projection grants no write, promotion, publication or Human-Acceptance authority.
publication_truth: SOURCE_BRANCH_PREPARED; external HTTP observation must be established independently when required.
